spell.ironspell_more.lightning_strike.gu: Summons a lightning bolt to strike target area.
spell.ironspell_more.thunder_step.guide: Dash instantly forward, zapping all enemies along the path.
spell.ironspell_more.spin_strike.guide: Perform a fiery spin attack forward, piercing through enemies and dealing damage.
spell.ironspell_more.pure_white_flame_bu: Grab a target within strict melee range and fling them forward, triggering an explosive burst followed by a cone wave. Imposes severe recoil penalties on the caster.
spell.ironspell_more.shackle_of_fear.gui: Launches a projectile that binds affected targets with chains.
